unrecoverable.base.digest: The SIF was built with `apptainer build docker-archive://wbm-lite.tar` from a Docker-saved tar that deploy_to_anvil.sh deletes after the build, and no base-image registry digest survives anywhere in the artifact — the deffile only names the local tar (`bootstrap: docker-archive` / `from: wbm-lite.tar`), and unlike v1/v2 there is no base-related label at all (`apptainer inspect --labels` shows nothing under `org.opencontainers.image.*`).
unrecoverable.supportsCode: wbm-tools-lite embeds its own copy of the three utility scripts (images/wbm-tools-lite/wbm/, at /wbm/utilities in the SIF) and binds no model code; it carries no `wbm_version` label, so there is no WBM version range for it to declare support for.
unrecoverable.verification.against: test_lite.slurm is a functional test with no reference output to compare against: it runs the three utilities on the v1.0.0 Global staging snapshot's wbm_output/ (used as input) and prints each output's shape next to the expected one.
